source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains female group, slavery metaphor and teaching role.
key_decisions.before: Older women likewise are to be reverent in behavior, not slanderers or enslaved to much wine, but teachers of what is good,
key_decisions.after: Older women likewise are to be reverent in conduct, not slanderers or enslaved to much wine, but teachers of what is good,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Older women likewise are to be reverent in behavior, not slanderers or slaves to much wine. They are to teach what is good,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps intergenerational instruction and both family loves.
key_decisions.before: so that they may train the younger women to love their husbands and children,
key_decisions.after: so that they may train the young women to love their husbands and children,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and so train the young women to love their husbands and children,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves gendered household expectations and reputational rationale.
key_decisions.before: to be self-controlled, pure, workers at home, kind, and responsive to their own husbands, so that God’s word is not slandered.
key_decisions.after: to be self-controlled, pure, workers at home, good and submissive to their own husbands, so that God's word may not be slandered.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to be self-controlled, pure, working at home, kind, and subject to their own husbands, so that the word of God may not be reviled.

key_decisions.rationale: Names enslaved people and masters and preserves the coercive submission command.
key_decisions.before: Slaves are to be responsive to their own masters in everything, seeking to please them, not talking back,
key_decisions.after: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be pleasing and not talk back,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Slaves are to be subject to their own masters in everything; they are to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps prohibited appropriation, trustworthiness and adornment metaphor.
key_decisions.before: not stealing, but showing complete good faith, so that in everything they may adorn the teaching of God our Savior.
key_decisions.after: not stealing, but demonstrating complete good faith, so that in everything they may adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: not pilfering, but showing all good faith, so that in everything they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves grace's epiphany and universal reach.
key_decisions.before: For God’s grace has appeared, bringing salvation for all people,
key_decisions.after: For God's grace has appeared, bringing salvation to all people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation for all people,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains hope/appearing and the dense divine title.
key_decisions.before: while we wait for the blessed hope and the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
key_decisions.after: while we wait for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: waiting for our blessed hope, the appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps self-gift, redemption, purification and eager action.
key_decisions.before: who gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and cleanse for himself a people as his own possession, zealous for good works.
key_decisions.after: He gave himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and cleanse for himself a people of his own, zealous for good works.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who gave himself for us that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people of his own who are zealous for good deeds.
